name: Battle of Hillsbrad
summary: In Hillsbrad town, Forsaken forces strike to break human rule. High Executor Darthalia directs the assault from Tarren Mill.

sections.title: Decapitating the Town Council
sections.body: Hillsbrad’s human defenders hold to their authority despite heavy losses in the fields and among the patrols. High Executor Darthalia knows the peasants and militia rally behind the town’s leaders. So she sends Forsaken operatives into the Town Hall to kill Magistrate Burnside and five councilmen. Without them, the town loses its command.

sections.title: Erasing the Civic Record
sections.body: Darthalia seeks to break Hillsbrad’s civic life as well as its leadership. She orders operatives to burn the Hillsbrad Proclamation, a political document bound to the settlement’s charter and pride. They also seize the town registry from surviving Alliance loyalists. Its official records and citizen rolls give Undercity’s intelligence a detailed view of the local people.

faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia, the Forsaken commander at Tarren Mill, directs the assault. It is part of her campaign against Alliance settlements in the foothills.
Magistrate Burnside leads Hillsbrad’s human government. He is in the Town Hall with his councilors and uses arcane magic to defend the town’s remaining authority.
The Hillsbrad Proclamation is a political charter kept in the Town Hall. It embodies the town’s law and civic pride, so its destruction strikes at local morale.

faq.q: Why does Darthalia want the town registry?
faq.answer: The town registry holds a census and civic records for Hillsbrad’s people. Taking it deprives surviving humans of their records and gives the Forsaken information about who remains nearby.

faq.q: Where does this fight take place?
faq.answer: The targets lie in and around Hillsbrad’s large Town Hall. The human settlement stands in the southern foothills between Tarren Mill and Southshore.

faq.q: What role do the councilmen play?
faq.answer: The Hillsbrad Councilmen help Magistrate Burnside govern the town. They are spellcasters who defend the Town Hall and its surrounding grounds.

angles.text: For the Horde, striking the Town Hall weakens the Alliance’s ability to coordinate local militia. It also helps secure Tarren Mill’s southern frontier from human counterattacks.
As an Undead, you see the Forsaken campaign against Hillsbrad’s human rule as both expansion and retribution. The living dispute Lordaeron’s borders.
For the Alliance, Magistrate Burnside’s death and the burning of the town charter mark the fall of Hillsbrad’s last legitimate local government.
